raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
- [ ] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?

Main counterpart of #6910.

Keep ordinary DSA sparse-attention backward shapes static when top-k contains
empty query rows, removing its dynamic `nonzero`/compact/gather/scatter path.

The generic path replaces each empty row with a safe one-tile cuDNN invocation:
its first index is zero, its effective top-k length is one, and its `dO`/`LSE`
are zeroed before backward. The returned `dQ` is explicitly zeroed for those
rows, so the safe tile contributes neither query nor KV gradients. A conservative
host-side certificate retains the existing allocation-free fast path when all
rows are provably nonempty.

This covers both the combined fused path and the split path used by IndexShare
and MTP sharing. It does not change CSA, THD/CP layout, MTP sharing semantics,
configuration, or the full-iteration CUDA Graph validator.

## Issue tracking

Linked issue: N/A

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [x] I have added proper typing to my code [Typing guidelines](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html)
- [ ] I have added relevant documentation
- [x] I have run the [autoformatter.sh](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/tools/autoformat.sh) on my PR

### Verification notes

- Unit/native parity: full and split paths; nonempty, mixed-empty, and all-empty
  rows; BF16/FP32; metadata immutability; zero-size rejection; batch isolation.
- H100 real cuDNN: split forward/backward and changing-pattern CUDA Graph replay
  passed. The combined cuDNN IndexerTopK forward is SM100-only and was covered on
  GB200.
- GB200 real cuDNN: split and combined eager/native parity and fixed-shape graph
  replay passed; no stale mask or replay allocation growth.
- 16-GPU GB200 GLM proxy ABBA: short THD 4K effective CP1 improved 2.38%; long
  THD 64K dynamic CP16 improved 3.19%; peak memory was unchanged in both cells.
- Nsight Systems 2026.4.1: candidate DSA backward traces contain no target
  `nonzero`, `index_select`, `index_copy`, or dynamic gather/scatter operations.


### Update (2026-10-26)

- Rebased onto current `main` (`e3f528380c`). The original commit is unchanged: its patch-id is the same as before the rebase.
- Added a second commit, `fix(dsa): do not certify non-empty top-k rows for KPool without tail selection`. This is the dev fix #8536 applied to this PR.
  - Why: `main` now has KPool selection (#7522). KPool without `dsa_indexer_kpool_always_select_tail` leaves the rows before a query's first complete pool with no key. The host-side certificate added here cannot see that, so it would skip the empty-row handling for exactly those rows.
  - The layer now certifies nothing in that mode.
  - A new CPU test (`test_dsa_topk_nonempty_certificate.py`) covers both tail settings. Its `no-tail` case fails without the fix.
- CPU, after the rebase: `test_dsa_native_parity.py` gives 67 passed, and `test_attention_variant_dsa.py` 53 passed. The remaining failures and errors (3 and 34) are identical on unmodified `main` and come from the CPU environment.
- `CHECK_ONLY=true BASE_REF=main tools/autoformat.sh` passes.
- The GPU results above predate the rebase and have not been re-run on it.

+    config = _make_config()
+    producer = _make_cpu_layer(config, 1)
+    assert not producer.skip_topk
+    pool_size = 2
+    indexer = producer.indexer
+    indexer.index_kpool = pool_size
+    indexer.index_kpool_always_select_tail = always_select_tail
+    indexer.index_kpool_use_quantization = False
+    indexer.index_kpool_compress_ape = torch.zeros(pool_size, 8)
+
+    def kpool_forward_before_topk(x, qr, packed_seq_params):
+        q, k, weights = _fake_forward_before_topk(x, qr, packed_seq_params)
+        indexer._kpool_gate_score = torch.zeros_like(k)
+        return q, k, weights
+
+    indexer.forward_before_topk = kpool_forward_before_topk
+    # No explicit mask: a plain causal layout is the case the certificate can prove.
+    _cpu_forward(producer, _cpu_inputs(config), None, AttnMaskType.causal)
+
+    # The plain causal layout alone would prove every row non-empty.
+    assert [call.certificate for call in certificates] == [always_select_tail]
+    assert _all_rows_nonempty(certificates[0].topk) is always_select_tail
